data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and the Menu → Agencies → Bridges & Tunnels → Tolls by vehicle path, and it includes vehicle type as a parameter. It adds an extra "expand crossing" step and a "crossing" parameter (the true workflow's "facility"), and it gives two alternative navigation routes, so the steps are somewhat vague and an automation would have to choose between them and guess at the final view-rate step.
